articles.title: Ikebukuro Tram Stop Living Furniture
articles.summary: The design turns a former Ikebukuro tram stop into living furniture. It recalls Toden tram lines that once ran toward Ueno and Sukiyabashi. The project evokes stories from the historic avenue.

articles.title: Legombang Treehouse Reimagines Balinese Family Home
articles.summary: Cave Urban reinterprets Balinese architecture as a tropical family home. It uses reclaimed timber, passive design, and a treehouse-like structure. The house was designed for co-founder Jed Long for his own family.

articles.title: La Joya House Tackles Steep Slope
articles.summary: La Joya House responds to a steep slope rising thirteen meters from the street. It turns the ascent into an architectural journey through San Agustinillo. The project includes three independent units.

articles.title: JCB House: Essential São Paulo Residence
articles.summary: JCB House is a minimal single-family residence in São Paulo. SUITE aimed for essential architecture that lets life unfold naturally. The project was developed between 2024 and 2026.

articles.title: Herdade da Matinha Rebuilt on Abandoned Estate
articles.summary: Herdade da Matinha is a rural tourism project on an abandoned Alentejo estate. Its 1917 chimney still stands among cork oaks and Vicentina Coast. SABRAB Architecture worked with owner Alfredo Moreira da Silva.

articles.title: Camposoto Health Center Fills Public Block
articles.summary: The Camposoto Health Center is part of a public facilities block. It sits in an urban expansion area with apartments and single-family homes nearby. The design integrates health facilities into the residential environment.

articles.title: Field Shelter Provides Simple Weather Refuge
articles.summary: Field Shelter provides a place to sit and rest in Nara. It is located among allotments and rice fields. Studio Armitage and Space Department designed and built it.

articles.title: Wuben Tiny Flashlight Packs 500 Lumens and Blade
articles.summary: Wuben’s tiny flashlight packs 500 lumens and a blade into 40 grams. It is designed for everyday carry. The reviewer says phone flashlights often handle after-dark tasks.

articles.summary: Breville introduces the Spiral Luxe, an automated pour‑over dripper that simplifies coffee preparation.

articles.title: BYREDO Steel Spheres Display
articles.summary: BYREDO reveals hidden landscapes inside fragrances using tiny steel spheres within each bottle.

articles.title: Gadgets revive features we never wanted to lose
articles.summary: Headphone jacks, removable batteries, and mechanical keyboards make nostalgic comebacks in modern devices.

articles.summary: The Red Dot Award recognizes Bobcat's RogueX3 machine for its breakthrough machine architecture.

articles.title: Tesla veteran, design legend build tiny trucks
articles.summary: A former Tesla engineer and renowned designer team up with a first‑time founder to launch compact trucks.

articles.title: Parisian‑inspired Napa bistro by FictionWorks
articles.summary: FictionWorks transformed a former taco spot into a layered lunchspot blending warm woods and stained glass.

articles.title: Maytoni Split Ceramic Table Lamp
articles.summary: Alexey Danilin’s Hope lamp uses split ceramic curves with concealed LEDs for dimmable table lighting.

articles.title: Flash Forest restores wildfire landscapes with seed capsules
articles.summary: Biodegradable capsule technology scatters native seeds and fungi to rehabilitate burnt Canadian terrain.

articles.summary: A curated exhibition of collectible furniture questions the mechanisms of power through modern design objects.

articles.title: Monos Vancouver Office by Ste Marie
articles.summary: Interior designer Ste Marie created the Monos headquarters to prioritize simplicity and shifting workspace moods.

articles.title: Cloud House by Peter Morris brings fairytale flamboyance to London
articles.summary: Architect Peter Morris designed the Cloud House in London with whimsical aesthetics. The residence features marshmallow-pink walls, sweeping arches, and turquoise detailing. The eccentric project combines two offset homes for Morris and partner Emily Kennedy.
